doc.title: Carmen Leggio interviewed by Monk Rowe, Tarrytown, New York, October 31, 1998

title: Photos: Kai Winding at the original Birdland and the Krupa quartet
summary: He shows the 1952 Birdland photo with Zoot Sims and Joe Newman, and the Krupa quartet with Doc Severinsen and Sal Nistico.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Now this is the one that’s going to amaze you. This is when I played two weeks with Kai Winding and here’s a picture of Zoot, Joe Newman, that’s the group there. That’s 1952.
This is Birdland. © Fillius Jazz Archive -20-
God, so small. Zoot Sims, wow look at that. Is that Billy Taylor on piano?
That’s Billy Taylor on piano, Joe Newman, Don Lamond.
No music on stage of course.
No, no. We played by heart. Now I’ll show you something else.
Clyde Lombardi. I don’t know that name.
Yeah. He was around that time. Now this is the Gene Krupa Quartet and then Doc Severinsen before he was famous.
Right. I played with Mel Torme. And Doc Severinsen on the bottom there before he was famous.
